mapper.select: SELECT NVL( (SELECT settlement_id FROM settlement WHERE period = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND company_id = #{value}), 0 ) AS settlement_id FROM dual
mapper.update: update settlement set total_pay=total_pay+#{total_pay} where settlement_id=#{settlement_id}
update settlement set total_pay=total_pay-#{total_pay} where settlement_id=#{settlement_id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id, c.company_name, s.period, s.total_pay, CASE WHEN s.total_pay < 0 THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS inout, s.payment_status, s.payment_date, s.payment_id FROM settlement s JOIN company c ON c.company_id = s.company_id WHERE s.period = TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') ORDER BY s.settlement_id
mapper.update: update settlement set payment_status='Y', payment_date=sysdate, payment_id=#{payment_id} where settlement_id=#{settlement_id}
